name: Electric lawn mower (corded)
note: Typical: BLACK+DECKER MM2000, 13 A. Needs a heavy outdoor cord; 100 ft is a stretch.

name: Leaf blower (corded)
note: Typical: BLACK+DECKER 3-in-1 Electric Leaf Blower. Usually 12 A. Use a 12 gauge outdoor cord for 50 ft or more.

name: String trimmer (corded)
note: Typical: BLACK+DECKER 2 in 1 String Trimmer/Edger Weed Wacker. About 5 A. A 16 gauge outdoor cord is fine up to about 100 ft.

name: Hedge trimmer (corded)
note: Typical: BLACK+DECKER Electric Hedge Trimmer. About 4 A. Keep the cord behind you and away from the blade.

name: Chainsaw (corded)
note: Typical: WEN CP1518 Electric Chainsaw. 14-15 A: at the limit of a household outlet. Short, thick cord only.

name: Pole saw (corded)
note: Typical: PORTLAND 6.5 A, 9.5 in. electric pole saw (Harbor Freight 56808). 6.5 A. A 16 gauge outdoor cord is fine up to about 100 ft.

name: Pressure washer (electric)
note: Typical: WEN PW2300 2300 PSI Electric Pressure Washer. 13-15 A. Many manuals say use a longer hose instead of a longer cord. Always on a GFCI.

name: Wood chipper / leaf mulcher (electric)
note: Typical: WEN 41119 Electric Wood Chipper and Shredder. About 15 A with a hard start. Plug in close to the outlet.

name: Garden tiller / cultivator (electric)
note: Typical: WEN TC1014 10-Amp 14-Inch Electric Tiller and Cultivator. About 10 A.

name: Lawn dethatcher (corded)
note: Typical: Sun Joe AJ805E 15 in. dethatcher/scarifier, 13 A. Use a 12 gauge outdoor cord for 50 ft or more.

name: Bug zapper
note: Typical: Flowtron 40W Outdoor Bug Zapper. Small load; usually runs all night.

name: Snow blower (corded electric)
note: Typical: WEN 5670 Snow Blaster 15-Amp 20-Inch Electric Snow Thrower. 13-15 A. Use the thickest, shortest outdoor cord you can; cold makes cords stiff.

name: Snow shovel (electric, corded)
note: Typical: Snow Joe 324E 10 A electric snow shovel. About 10 A.

name: Snow blower electric start button
note: Typical: WEN SB24 24-Inch 212cc Two-Stage Self-Propelled Gas-Powered Snow Blowe. Only for the few seconds it cranks the engine, but it pulls hard. Unplug once running.

name: Engine block heater
note: Typical: Kat's 600 W lower radiator hose heater. Usually 400-1000 W; check the cord tag. Runs for hours, so use a 14 gauge or thicker outdoor cord. A timer saves power.

name: Roof / gutter de-icing cable (100 ft)
note: Typical: Easy Heat ADKS-500 roof cable, 100 ft. About 5 W per foot. Must be on a GFCI.

name: Pipe heat cable (about 30 ft)
note: Typical: Easy Heat pipe heating cable. Roughly 3-8 W per foot depending on the brand.

name: Heated driveway mat
note: Typical: HeatTrak Heated Snow & Ice Melting Driveway Mat. Varies a lot by size; check the label.

name: LED Christmas lights (100-bulb string)
note: Typical: Holiday Wonderland 100-bulb mini LED set. Check the tag for how many strings can be connected end to end (often 20-40+).

name: Incandescent mini lights (100-bulb string)
note: Typical: Holiday Wonderland 100-bulb mini incandescent set. Old-style strings: usually only 3 can be connected end to end.

name: LED C9 lights (25-bulb string)
note: Typical: Holiday Wonderland 25-bulb C9 LED set. Check the tag for the end-to-end limit.

name: Incandescent C9 lights (25-bulb string)
note: Typical: Holiday Wonderland 25-bulb C9 incandescent set. Big old-style bulbs. 4 strings already need a 14 gauge cord at 100 ft.

name: Inflatable yard decoration
note: Typical: Brite Star 6 ft Santa sleigh inflatable. A fan plus lights: usually 50-150 W.

name: Holiday light projector
note: Typical: Prime Wire & Cable 5 W laser projector. Very small load.

name: LED flood light
note: Typical: Lepro outdoor LED flood light. Replaces a 250-500 W halogen.

name: Halogen work light
note: Typical: Designers Edge 500 W halogen tripod light. Gets very hot. Keep away from anything that can burn.

name: LED work light
note: Typical: Feit Electric 5000 lm foldable LED work light. Much cooler and lighter load than halogen.

name: Heated pet bed
note: Typical: K&H Original Lectro-Kennel Outdoor Heated Pet Pad. Small ones use 4-6 W; outdoor pads up to about 40-60 W.

name: Heated pet water bowl
note: Typical: K&H Thermal-Bowl Heated Outdoor Water Bowl. Usually 25-100 W.

name: Heated bird bath
note: Typical: K&H Super Ice Eliminator Bird Bath Deicer. Usually 75-200 W.

name: Heated poultry waterer
note: Typical: K&H Poultry Waterer. Runs all winter. Keep the plug connection off the ground and dry.

name: Stock tank heater
note: Typical: K&H Ultimate Stock Tank Deicer. Uses as much as a space heater, around the clock. 12 gauge outdoor cord and its own GFCI outlet.

name: Heat lamp (250 W bulb)
note: Typical: Do it 10 in. brooder heat lamp. A common barn fire cause. Clamp it securely, with a guard, away from bedding.

name: Brooder heat plate
note: Typical: RentACoop 12x12 in. heating plate (22 W). Safer than a heat lamp for chicks.

name: Electric fence charger (plug-in)
note: Typical: Dare Power Pro plug-in fence charger. Tiny load; usually 2-10 W.

name: Shop vac
note: Typical: Shop-Vac 6 Gallon 3.5 Peak HP Wet/Dry Vac. Label usually says 12-13 A. Short bursts, but a big starting pull.

name: Circular saw
note: Typical: WEN 36725 12A 7-1/4-Inch Sidewinder Circular Saw. Usually 15 A. 12 gauge cord, as short as possible.

name: Miter saw
note: Typical: WEN MM1215 15-Amp 12-Inch Dual Bevel Sliding Compound Miter Saw. Usually 15 A.

name: Table saw (job site)
note: Typical: WEN TT-1015 15-Amp 2 HP 10-Inch Industrial Benchtop Jobsite Table Saw. Usually 15 A. Don't run another big tool on the same circuit.

name: Reciprocating saw
note: Typical: WEN 3630 10-Amp 8-Position Variable Speed Reciprocating Saw. Usually 10-12 A.

name: Angle grinder
note: Typical: WEN 94475 7.5-Amp 4-1/2-Inch Angle Grinder. Usually 7-11 A.

name: Drill (corded)
note: Typical: BLACK+DECKER Hammer Drill. Usually 5-8 A.

name: Bench grinder
note: Typical: WEN BG4276 2.1-Amp 6-Inch Single Speed Bench Grinder. Usually 2-4 A.

name: Air compressor (pancake, 6 gal)
note: Typical: Bostitch 6 gal pancake compressor. Starts hard every time it cycles. Manuals usually say add air hose instead of extension cord.

name: Air compressor (27 gal vertical)
note: Typical: FORTRESS FT27200, 27 gal, 200 PSI oil-free (Harbor Freight 56403). Label: 120 V, 15 A, 1.6 HP. That's a full 15 A outlet by itself: plug it straight into the wall with nothing else on that circuit, and use a longer air hose instead of an extension cord.

name: Tire inflator (120 V)
note: Typical: BLACK+DECKER BDINF20C inflator (plugs into 120 V or runs on battery). Small plug-in inflators; check the label.

name: Heat gun
note: Typical: WEN HG112V 12.5-Amp Variable-Temperature Heat Gun. Usually 12-13 A.

name: Flux-core welder (120 V)
note: Typical: Lincoln Electric WELD-PAK 90i FC. Usually needs a 20 A outlet. Too much for a household extension cord; see the manual for the cord size it allows.

name: Garage ceiling fan / box fan
note: Typical: Lasko Cool Colors 20" Box Fan. Usually 50-120 W.

name: Space heater
note: Typical: Lasko 16" Ceramic Tower Space Heater. Pulls the most of anything in the house. Give it its own wall outlet.

name: Oil-filled radiator heater
note: Typical: Dreo Oil-filled Radiator 153. Same load as any space heater: wall outlet only.

name: Patio heater (electric)
note: Typical: Westinghouse WES31-1592 wall-mount infrared heater. 12.5 A for hours. Outdoor 12 gauge cord, kept short, on a GFCI.

name: Window air conditioner (small)
note: Typical: BLACK+DECKER 5,000 BTU Mechanical Window Air Conditioner. 5,000-6,000 BTU units. Plug straight into the wall.

name: Portable air conditioner
note: Typical: BLACK+DECKER 8,000 BTU SACC/CEC. Plug straight into the wall.

name: Dehumidifier
note: Typical: hOmeLabs 40 Pint Dehumidifier. Most manuals say no extension cords.

name: Electric blanket
note: Typical: Sunbeam heated microplush throw. Usually 50-200 W.

name: Sump pump (1/3 HP)
note: Typical: Wayne 1/3 HP stainless sump pump. Plug straight into a GFCI wall outlet.

name: Utility / transfer pump
note: Typical: Wayne 1/4 HP submersible utility pump. For draining. Keep the plug end high and dry.

name: Fountain / pond pump (small)
note: Typical: TotalPond 160 GPH Fountain Pump. Usually 20-100 W. GFCI outlet.

name: Pond de-icer
note: Typical: K&H Thermo-Pond 3.0 Pond Deicer. Usually 250-1500 W around the clock. GFCI outlet.

name: Electric smoker
note: Typical: Masterbuilt 30-Inch Digital Electric Smoker. Runs for hours. 14 gauge outdoor cord, kept short.

name: Pellet grill
note: Typical: Z Grills PIONEER 450B PELLET GRILL. About 300 W while the igniter heats, then about 50 W.

name: Electric griddle / hot plate
note: Typical: Chefman All-Purpose Nonstick Large Griddle. Don't share the circuit with other cooking.

name: Slow cooker
note: Typical: Chefman 7 Qt. Slow Cooker. Usually 150-300 W.

name: Coffee maker
note: Typical: Chefman Caffeinator 14-Cup Programmable Coffee Maker. Usually 600-1200 W.

name: Microwave
note: Typical: Avanti 1.1 cu ft 1000 W microwave. A "1000 W" microwave pulls about 1500 W from the wall. Plug straight in.

name: Electric kettle
note: Typical: Chefman Fast-Boil 1.8L Electric Kettle. Short use, but at the limit with anything else on.

name: Mini fridge
note: Typical: Avanti 1.6 cu ft cube fridge. Fridge makers say no extension cords. Starting pull is several times the running watts.

name: Chest freezer
note: Typical: BLACK+DECKER 3.5 Cu. Ft. Chest Freezer. Fridge makers say no extension cords.

name: Battery maintainer (trickle charger)
note: Typical: Battery Tender Junior (0.75 A to the battery), only about 0.2-0.4 A from the wall. Bigger chargers pull much more; check the Input line on the label.

name: DEWALT 4 A waterproof charger/maintainer (DXAEWPC4)
note: Label input: 120 V, 1.2 A while charging; much less once it's just maintaining. Waterproof (IP67), fine outdoors.

name: BLACK+DECKER 2 A waterproof charger/maintainer (BC2WBD)
note: About 0.5 A from the wall. Waterproof, fine outdoors.

name: Battery charger (10 A)
note: Typical: Schumacher Electric 10A Car Battery Charger and Maintainer. Check the input amps on the label (often 1.5-2 A). Engine-start chargers pull much more while starting.

name: Power tool battery charger
note: Typical: BLACK+DECKER 12V MAX/20V MAX Lithium Ion Battery Charger. Usually 50-150 W.

name: E-bike charger
note: Typical: Rad Power Bikes Rad Battery Charger. Usually 100-250 W for several hours.

name: Electric car charger (Level 1)
note: Typical: Lectron Portable Level 1 J1772 EV Charger. 12 A for 10+ hours. Car makers say plug straight into a dedicated wall outlet, no extension cord.

name: Laptop charger
note: Typical: Anker Nano 45 W USB-C charger. Usually 45-100 W.

name: Phone charger
note: Typical: Anker 523 Nano 3 USB-C charger. Tiny load.

name: Wi-Fi router / modem
note: Typical: TP-Link Archer AX21. Tiny load.

name: Security camera (plug-in)
note: Typical: Wyze Cam v4. Tiny load. Outdoors, keep the plug in a weatherproof box.

name: TV
note: Typical: TCL 55 in. 4-Series Google TV. Usually 50-200 W.

name: Radio / Bluetooth speaker
note: Typical: soundcore 3. Small load.
